judgments.rewrite_hint: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” Narrow the recipient to the people or businesses on the calls, rather than Muse users; see MUSE-HC-006.

“So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.” Remove the unsupported claim about what call recipients believed; narrow this to the confirmed lack of proper disclosure and the use of human contract staff. See MUSE-HC-012.

“information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.” Keep this as an attributed concern about information that might be shared, not as definite handling of private data. See MUSE-HC-010.
